title: Implement a sequential Count-Min Sketch
prompt: Return a sequential Count-Min Sketch with deterministic row-seeded BLAKE2b hashes, nonnegative integer updates, and minimum-counter estimates. Python integers avoid counter overflow. Byte keys are hashed directly, string keys as UTF-8. It is a reference model, not the resume's lock-free C++ implementation.
